channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Lectures in History
channel.desc: When Kentucky became a state in 1792, it had a choice: keep slavery or abolish it. University of Kentucky professor Melanie Goan teaches a class on the state's relationship with the institution of slavery until the 1863 Emancipation Proclamation.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Historian and former Harvard University president Drew Gilpin Faust reflects on the life and legacy of President James Buchanan. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday this year.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Mathew Brady Story and the Clara Barton Story
channel.desc: This 1961 U.S. Army film tells the stories about both famed Civil War photographer Mathew Brady and Clara Barton, founder of the American Red Cross in 1881.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Presidency
channel.desc: Historian Diana Carlin analyzes the life of Julia Grant using the first lady's memoirs. The Ulysses S. Grant Historic Site hosts this event.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: C-SPAN Visits the Golden Spike National Historic Site
channel.desc: C-SPAN visits the Golden Spike Site at Promontory, Utah, where the Central Pacific and Union Pacific railroads joined to mark the completion of the first transcontinental railroad on May 10, 1869.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Harvard University history professor Annette Gordon-Reed reflects on the life and legacy of President Andrew Johnson. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Historians explore the ideas that sparked the American Revolution, as well as the key personalities and enduring impact of the Revolutionary Era. The event is organized by the Jack Miller Center and The American Revolution Institute.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Civil War
channel.desc: Author Jonathan Jones discusses America's first opioid epidemic, which comprised veterans taking opium and morphine to ease distress after the Civil War.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Reel America
channel.desc: This 1944 documentary, which was intended to encourage African Americans to enlist in the U.S. Army during World War II, traces the history of African-American contributions to society during war and peace.

channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Journalist and author Lois Romano reflects on the life and legacy of First Lady Mary Todd Lincoln. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday this year.

channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Retired Army General Stanley McChrystal reflects on the life and legacy of President Ulysses Grant. His essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Scholar Yuval Levin reflects on the life and legacy of First Lady Julia Grant (1869-77). His essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday this year.

channel.title: W. Fitzhugh Brundage, A Fate Worse Than Hell

channel.desc: C-SPAN tours the African American Civil War Memorial Museum in Washington, D.C., which honors the roles of 209,145 U.S. Colored Troops who served in the Union Army.

channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Scholars gathered by the Abraham Lincoln Institute explore how Lincoln viewed concepts in the Declaration of Independence and how they shaped his policies. The event takes place at the Ford's Theatre in Washington, D.C.

channel.title: Reel America
channel.desc: This 1944 documentary, which was intended to encourage African Americans to enlist in the U.S. Army during World War II, traces the history of African-American contributions to society during war and peace.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Civil War
channel.desc: Author Tom Zoellner discusses escaped slaves, contraband camps, and the grassroots nature of emancipation during the Civil War.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Civil War
channel.desc: Historians discuss the Civil War, covering topics such as the USS Monitor and USS Cairo warships, field hospital burials, missing soldiers and Confederate troops who did not surrender at Appomattox.

channel.title: American History TV
channel.desc: Airing weekends, "American History TV" offers programming about people and events that document the American story, geared toward history aficionados. Shows that air under the "American History TV" banner cover the history of the nation, from its founding in the 18th century through modern times. Topics covered include the Civil War, presidents and the exploration of historical sites.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Civil War
channel.desc: Historian Cheryl McAuley discusses Thaddeus Lowe, a Civil War aeronaut, scientist, and inventor who became known as the founder of military aerial reconnaissance.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: C-SPAN Visits the Golden Spike National Historic Site
channel.desc: C-SPAN visits the Golden Spike Site at Promontory, Utah, where the Central Pacific and Union Pacific railroads joined to mark the completion of the first transcontinental railroad on May 10, 1869.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Civil War
channel.desc: Historians discuss the Civil War's events of 1865 at the National Museum of the Civil War Soldier in Petersburg, Virginia.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Chelsea Follett, The Grim Old Days
channel.desc: Cato Institute fellow Chelsea Follett talks about the harsh reality of life before the advancements of the 18th-century Industrial Revolution.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Rebecca Blumenstein and Diana Kapp, The Last Free Women
channel.desc: NBC News President-Editorial Rebecca Blumenstein and journalist Diana Kapp talk about Afghan women who escaped from Afghanistan in 2021 and made a new life in America.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Carlos Gutierrez, Sheer Will
channel.desc: Former Commerce Secretary and CEO of Kellogg's, Carlos Gutierrez, talks about his life and career in business and government.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Heywood Hill Bookshop & the Global Reading Census
channel.desc: Nicky Dunne, chair of Heywood Hill in London, discusses the history of his 90-year-old royally chartered bookstore and his effort to conduct a global reading census.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: J. Vanessa Lyon, Blackness Thirteen Ways
channel.desc: C-SPAN's Book TV is in Nashville for the 2026 Southern Festival of Books.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Stephen Kinzer, Boiling Point
channel.desc: Author Stephen Kinzer talks about Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and the decades-long involvement of the U.S. in the country.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Peter Laufer, We Are All Americans
channel.desc: University of Oregon journalism professor Peter Laufer discusses his trips across America in 2001, 2011, and 2021 to see how the country changed in the aftermath of 9/11.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Will Haygood, The War Within
channel.desc: Book TV presents coverage of the 2026 History Book Festival in Lewes, Delaware.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Ada Ferrer, Keeper of my Kin -- Memoir of an Immigrant Daughter
channel.desc: Book TV presents coverage of the 2026 History Book Festival in Lewes, Delaware.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: Cristin Aptowicz, The Ballad of the Fugitive William Parker
channel.desc: Author Cristin Aptowicz discusses the 1851 Christiana Resistance, a challenge to the Fugitive Slave Law that many call the first shots of the Civil War.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: David Conrad-Perez, Fire in the Heart of the City
channel.desc: Book TV presents coverage of the 2026 History Book Festival in Lewes, Delaware.[(96057)]

channel.name: CSPAN 3 US
channel.title: Book TV
channel.desc: This long-running staple of the C-SPAN2 weekend schedule helps expand the channel's programming beyond politics. Most episodes of "Book TV" feature discussions with authors of nonfiction books, usually in the form of interviews, lectures or seminars. The series sometimes includes coverage of major book fairs and festivals. Some of the notable names who have appeared on the show include David Mamet and Tom Clancy.

channel.desc: Fr. Connor discusses that Christ rises from the dead and sends the Holy Spirit to all, fulfilling his own promises and that of the Hebrew Scriptures, proving his divine authority and causing our own spiritual and bodily resurrection. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ma Vie Avec Dieu
channel.desc: Fr. Antoine Thomas shows how Sacred Scripture reveals Jesus' desire to continue his work through the disciples in the Church. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Canada Catholique
channel.desc: Dans cet ?pisode de Canada catholique, l?animateur Francis Denis se rend dans les provinces maritimes pour d?couvrir une foi aussi solide que les c?tes escarp?es de la r?gion. Il explore le travail dynamique de NET Canada, une organisation catholique enti?rement d?di? ? l??vang?lisation de la jeunesse et qui ravive la foi ? travers le pays. Dans la troisi?me partie de l??mission, il nous pr?sente son entrevue avec Mgr Christian Riesbeck CC, ?v?que de Saint-Jean au Nouveau Brunswick, et qui partage sa vision de l??glise dans le monde d?aujourd?hui. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Daily Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, AL. (LIVE DAILY at 8 am Eastern). (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Fathers For Good
channel.desc: Fr. Francis Gustilo and Frank Padilla discuss the need for men to know and accept themselves while taking responsibility for their personal lives. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn Live
channel.desc: Every Wednesday night, Fr. Mitch Pacwa, interviews various guests seeking to teach and prepare us for evangelism. Learn more about your faith and reawaken your desire to bring others to the Church. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Living The Christian Way
channel.desc: Fr. Jeffrey Kirby and Kathy Schmugge explore the unique roles of men and women in the Church, as they debate two polarizing topics - the male priesthood and gender equality through the perspective of the Catholic faith. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Life On The Rock
channel.desc: Mario Enzler returns to continue sharing his Swiss Guard memories, recalling St. John Paul II's authentic leadership and the Rosary that the saint called his most powerful weapon. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Father Spitzer?s Universe
channel.desc: Father Spitzer and Doug Keck discuss Father?s book, Healing the Culture. Father explains that materialism accepted by today?s culture leads us to ignore the spiritual reality that surrounds us. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: On Assignment Magazine: Holiday Edition
channel.desc: A showcase of special holiday gatherings and meals hosted for the homeless and poor from Thanksgiving to Christmas. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Zambie, Precheurs De La Route
channel.desc: Dans l?arri?re-pays de la Zambie, les vastes espaces et la nature dispers?e des villages signifient que les pr?tres et les religieuses doivent parcourir de grandes distances sur un terrain accident? pour atteindre et servir les fid?les. Cela n?est pas sans risque. Non seulement on a besoin d?un moyen de transport s?r, mais l?entretien des v?hicules est une pr?occupation permanente et comporte des co?ts r?currents. Le documentaire regarde l?arri?re-plan de l?activit? missionnaire des m?caniciens ? eux-m?mes pr?tres et missionnaires ? qui entretiennent les jeeps et les bateaux qui permettent ? la parole de Dieu d?atteindre et de donner de l?espoir aux fid?les isol?s. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Living Divine Mercy
channel.desc: Fr. Chris Alar, M.I.C. helps viewers get a better understanding of the Divine Mercy message, and shares powerful, real life examples of people who live Divine Mercy in their every day lives. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The New Evangelization
channel.desc: Pope John Paul II arrived at a time when the Church seemed long defeated. Hosts Michael Hernon, Dr. Ralph Martin and Dr. Scott Hahn re-discover Pope John Paul II?s vision for the Church?s renewed mission. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Squint
channel.desc: The story of an old and humble pilgrim who has a major influence on a worldly young man. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Called To Communion With Dr. David Anders
channel.desc: A televised format of Dr. David Anders? popular and engaging radio show that asks atheists, former Catholics, and non-Catholics: "What is stopping you from becoming Catholic?". (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Pakistan ?not To Look Away?
channel.desc: Encounter the colossal testimony of love and service of Sister Ruth Pfau, who changed the landscape of Pakistan forever by serving women, men, and children suffering from leprosy. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Daily Mass
channel.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, AL. (LIVE DAILY at 8 am Eastern). (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Holy Land Rosary
channel.desc: Fr. Mitch Pacwa leads the Sorrowful Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the Rosary meditations. (18 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: The Litany Of The Most Precious Blood Of Jesus
channel.desc: Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama, as they recite this beautiful prayer in honor of the Precious Blood of Jesus shed for our salvation. (12 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Forgotten Heritage
channel.desc: Frs. Hogan and Gorman share the life of the Irish Saint Columbanus and relate how it was Irish monks who actually saved civilization. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Mother Angelica Live Classics
channel.desc: Mother challenges everyone to not just celebrate Thanksgiving but to really reflect on what we are thankful for. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Women Of Grace
channel.desc: Hosted by Johnnette Benkovic Williams, Women of Grace encourages and affirms women in their dignity as daughters of God and in their gift of authentic femininity. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Ewtn News Special Exclusive: U.s. Ambassador Brian Burch On Representing America At The Vatican
channel.desc: Brian Burch is the United States Ambassador to the Holy See in Rome. EWTN's Colm Flynn sits down with Ambassador Burch to talk to him about representing his country to the Vatican during the first pontificate of an American Pope. They talk about ongoing issues around the world including the US's capture of the Venezuelan president, the tragedy in Minnesota, and more. They also talk about Ambassador Burch's own faith, and what this assignment means to him. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Walsingham Stories
channel.desc: On his pilgrimage to the United Kingdom, Br. Nathanael Campion takes time to share his story with James McCullough and talk about his religious community, Servants of Christ Jesus. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Holocaust Symphony No. 3
channel.desc: World-renowned pianist and composer Richard Nanes performs a powerful meditation of the Holocaust. Martin Bookspan delivers a commentary. (60 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Life Is Worth Living
channel.desc: Archbishop Sheen tells a story of patriotism, investigates the two kinds of revolutions, yesterday and today, and explains why every day in America should be Thanksgiving Day. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Stations Of The Cross
channel.desc: Using St. Alphonsus Liguori's Prayers as a guide, pray the traditional Stations of the Cross aiding your meditation with live-action images from Christ's Passion. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: new! Catholic Sphere
channel.desc: Every week host Doug Keck brings on a panel of 3 experts to tackle topics on the minds of Catholics. From theology to social media, from young parents to the universal church, surround yourself with solid answers as you enter the Catholic Sphere! (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Living The Christian Way
channel.desc: Fr. Jeffrey Kirby and Kathy Schmugge explore the unique roles of men and women in the Church, as they debate two polarizing topics - the male priesthood and gender equality through the perspective of the Catholic faith. (30 minutes).

channel.name: EWTN ZA
channel.title: Global Divine Mercy Chaplet
channel.desc: Children from around the world pray the Chaplet of Divine Mercy. (30 minutes).[(96057)]

The program aims to explore the fundamental values and principles of American society, politics, culture, and current events and the impact that these things have on the nation's future and the everyday lives of the citizens. Levin also hosts "The Mark Levin Show," and prior to joining FOX, he served as an adviser to some of President Ronald Reagan's cabinet members.

channel.name: Law & Crime US
channel.title: Cops Reloaded
channel.desc: "Cops" has been producing new episodes for more than 20 years, and with daily repeats of the iconic series entering their second decade on the air, producers felt it was time for a change to freshen things up, which is how the idea for "Cops Reloaded" was born. This entry in the long-running franchise takes footage from previous episodes and re-edits it to produce new episodes. Some of the program's wildest criminals, most memorable car chases, and craziest moments are featured on "Reloaded."
